author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we go hands-on with the all-new MSI PRO MAX EDGE AI+, a 4-liter workstation that packs an unbelievable amount of power into a tiny footprint. Powered by the new AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16 Cores / 32 Threads), this mini PC features the monstrous Radeon 8060S iGPU and up to 128GB of LPDDR5X Unified Memory running at 8000MT/s! We can even allocate up to 96GB of that memory directly to the iGPU, making this a beast for local LLM deployment (up to 120B parameters offline), extreme multi-tasking, and 1440p AAA gaming
